messages:
alex (Procure): Heads up 1 — Deduply sent their renewal and some new language around billed tokens. They claim their dedupe is applied upstream so committed credits will only cover 'unique tokens'. I want to confirm auditability before we lock a commit.

nina (Finance): Can you drop the headline numbers? need to run a pro-forma tonight.

alex (Procure): Current avg month is ~900M tokens. Q2 pilot forecast 1.9B/mo. Deduply proposal: commit $28k/mo (they say covers up to 1.4B unique tokens), metered plan $0.025/1k tokens. Commit overage $0.012/1k. They also list "session/context" tokens billed at a separate line.

ravi (Platform): We already do client-side minimization, but vendor-side dedupe could target cross-session repeats. Important questions: window length (24h/7d/30d?), per-tenant vs global, fingerprinting tolerance (exact-match vs fuzzy).

nina (Finance): If their definition of 'unique' is too generous (e.g., before our client dedupe), then commit could underdeliver. Alex 1 ask them if committed credits apply to post-dedupe counts and whether cached embedding hits are excluded.

alex (Procure): Messaged sales: "Confirm: committed credits apply to tokens after your dedupe pipeline. Provide a sample dedupe report and define 'session/context' tokens. What's your overage rounding? Any minimum monthly seat/service fees?"

billing-bot: Note: last deduction for Deduply invoice INV-2026-01 had a 9% mismatch against our internal usage; ticket #1592 remains open for reconciliation.

zoe (Legal): Also flag termination and shortfall liability. If we commit and then usage drops, is there a clawback? We should negotiate a rolling 90-day true-up with credits or a partial refund. Add audit rights for redacted dedupe output.

ravi (Platform): For us, the ability to sample dedupe outputs is critical. Without that we can't trust their claim of 'unique tokens'. Ask for a redacted report with hash-prefixes and counts by window. Also: SLA on dedupe correctness and a bug bounty if they bill erroneously.

nina (Finance): I'll prepare three scenarios: conservative (no dedupe credits), neutral (50% net after dedupe), optimistic (70% net). Put the vendor numbers into the sheet and I'll share.

alex (Procure): Vendor replied: "Committed credits apply to post-dedupe unique tokens; context/session tokens count toward the commit; we can provide monthly redacted dedupe reports via S3; true-ups quarterly; no seat fees." They offered a 60-day POC with credits to validate.

zoe (Legal): Accept POC but add contract language: "right to inspect monthly redacted dedupe logs; definition of context tokens; quarterly reconciliations with resulting credits if misapplied." Also request indemnity for billing errors over a materiality threshold.

ravi (Platform): I'll run a simulated dedupe on last 45 days and post the delta numbers by EOD tomorrow. If vendor POC matches our sim within +/-5%, we can go commit route.

nina (Finance): Great. Alex 1 can you get the exact S3 format and sample schema? I want to automate ingest into the reconciliation pipeline.

alex (Procure): On it. TL;DR: POC + auditable reports + quarterly true-up likely pushes us to sign commit. If any piece missing, stay metered and push for hard caps and lower overage.
